== Hero Usage ==
* [[Hero]]es maintain this skill in and out of combat. They recast it when its duration is less than four seconds, thereby making use of its potential to boost its own strength.

== Notes ==

{{anomaly|Under rare circumstances, heroes with very low health will use a spell while under the effects of Masochism and accidentally kill themselves.}}
